TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the ATM.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Outcome of the financial transaction for the customer.

ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period assigned by the ATM.

Incident.name: Incident
Incident.definition: Incident occurring during the processing of the transaction.

TotalDepositedAmount.name: Total Deposited Amount
TotalDepositedAmount.definition: Total amount deposed by the customer.

TotalAuthorisedAmount.name: Total Authorised Amount
TotalAuthorisedAmount.definition: Total authorised amount of the deposit transaction.

AdditionalCharge.name: Additional Charge
AdditionalCharge.definition: Additional charge (for instance tax or fee).

RequestedReceipt.name: Requested Receipt
RequestedReceipt.definition: True if the customer has requested a receipt.|Usage: When absent, default value is False.

ReceiptPrinted.name: Receipt Printed
ReceiptPrinted.definition: True if a receipt has been printed and presented to the customer.|Usage: When absent, default value is True.

ToBeReconciledMediaCounters.name: To Be Reconciled Media Counters
ToBeReconciledMediaCounters.definition: Media unit not put in the safe. These deposits have to be reconciliated.

Cassette.name: Cassette
Cassette.definition: Information on the cassettes of the ATM.

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Sequence of one or more TLV data elements from the ATM application, in accordance with ISO 7816-6, not in a specific order. Present if the transaction is performed with an EMV chip card application.
